rules.character_identity: Preserve source pixels in v2 trial; no face synthesis.
rules.product_identity: Preserve source pixels; no generative replacement.
rules.environment_identity: Preserve source image identity and avoid contradictory screen direction.
rules.screen_contents: Do not invent readable UI text.
rules.subject_position: Prefer center continuity and prohibit unnecessary left-right-left jumps.
rules.focal_point: Keep adjacent focal points near each other unless a semantic reveal justifies a jump.
rules.scale_progression: Use intentional wide-medium-tight progression or explicit orientation reset.
rules.motion: Use motion to guide the eye toward the next cut; static holds are valid.
rules.cut_reason: Every cut requires establish, emphasis, detail, reaction, reveal, proof, payoff, beat, or offer.

known_limit: This v2 artifact validates continuity editing with source-preserving reframes only. True alternate-angle generative shots remain required before declaring final Standard complete.
